summary_md:
# Larmsignalerna tjuter

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-05-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Monday episode of DI's Kort och lång, the hosts note the market is holding up close to all-time highs even with oil at $111, rising global rates, expected Riksbank hikes and the Hormuz crisis. They say strong margins and US tech are the reason. They preview the week's reports, which are mostly positive: Nibe comes in with low expectations, and they rate Lagercrantz and Addtech as high-quality serial acquirers. They also flag warning signs, including Sivers Semiconductors delaying its report and restating its accounts, repeated mine collapses at Boliden, falling valuation multiples for defence stocks, and complex transactions in the SBB sphere.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIBE-B — Nibe | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Low expectations into Q1 report plus tailwind from Iran conflict/shift away from fossil fuels; stock flat past month.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see a 'good cocktail' ahead of the report: consensus expects only 0.7% growth while the energy crisis should boost demand for heat pumps. Stock has not moved in a month, so a small pre-report speculation is suggested. This is a short-term report trade, not a firm long-term call.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q1 report misses even low expectations
- no visible demand uplift from energy crisis
- Hormuz crisis resolves and oil falls sharply

> *"tacksamt låga förväntningar. Det brukar vara en bra cocktail att gå in med inför en rapport."*

---

### 🟢 LAGR-B — Lagercrantz | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

One of the best serial acquirers, ROCE north of 20% sustained, controlled balance sheet; not too expensive and cheaper than Addtech.

#### Reasoning

Johan Wendel says return on capital employed is the key metric for serial acquirers. He says Lagercrantz has kept it above 20% for a long time, which justifies a high multiple, and he does not find it too expensive. About 13% growth is expected. The stock often moves on report days, so the report is worth watching.

#### Sell Triggers

- ROCE falls below ~20%
- acquisition pace slows or multiples paid rise
- UK exposure hurt by public spending cuts

> *"Jag tycker faktiskt inte att varken Addtech eller Lagercrantz är för dyrt. Lagercrantz är väl lite billigare än vad Addtech är."*

---

### 🟢 ADDT-B — Addtech | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Well-run serial acquirer, stock -10% last month, host might put it in portfolio; not too expensive though pricier than Lagercrantz.

#### Reasoning

Addtech is seen as perhaps the best-run serial acquirer, and the host says it might be the one he would put in his portfolio. The 10% drop over the past month makes the valuation less stretched. Growth expectations are low because it has been cautious with acquisitions, and it reports late for an OMXS30 company.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued weak acquisition activity
- ROCE deterioration
- report disappoints on organic growth

> *"kanske den mest välskötta serieförvärvaren, kanske den jag hade lagt i portföljen"*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 75%

Report postponed to last allowed day, past results restated; auditor Deloitte possibly got cold feet; 'alarm signals are howling'.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see the delayed report and accounting restatement as red flags. They compare it to Oscar Properties and SBB, which also reported on the last allowed day as things went wrong. An accounting expert disputes the US-listing explanation. The stock is valued like an option with a very low chance of success, and the company has no real revenue or earnings yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- report on 29 May shows clean accounts and converting partnerships into revenue
- successful US listing with auditor sign-off

> *"Ett mer rakt sätt är att uttrycka det som att larmsignalerna tjuter."*

---

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Three mine collapses in short time; Garpenberg idle for long time; host argues higher risk premium warranted despite commodity tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Repeated collapses, including two at Garpenberg, Boliden's largest mine, mean production will be lost for a long time. The host thinks commodity analysts should price in a higher risk premium, and says Boliden 'feels a bit weak'. The commodity price tailwind from AI investment is still there. Hosts will keep an eye on it.

#### Sell Triggers

- further mine incidents
- extended Garpenberg outage beyond guidance

> *"om man nu vore råvaruanalytiker så borde man prissätta det här med lite högre riskpremie"*

---

### 🟠 SAAB-B — Saab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Multiple contraction, Citi upgraded sell to neutral; cash-flow concerns; host still deciding top pick in defence sector.

#### Reasoning

Defence valuations have fallen since January. Citi, as an outside analyst, raised Saab from sell to neutral. The host says Saab's weak cash flow and the challenge of earning returns on its large order book are concerns. Long-term demand is intact, and the host promised to come back on which defence stock is the top pick.

#### Sell Triggers

- cash flow fails to improve
- political pressure forces pre-contract investments hurting returns

> *"jag har satt och funderat på det där i helgen, vilket som är toppicket i sektorn. Ingen bra slutsats än."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Reports Wednesday with ~79% expected growth; could beat, but host worried about chip price pressure and rising inference-chip competition.

#### Reasoning

One host expects another beat with positive guidance after strong hyperscaler reports. The other worries that high chip prices will come under pressure as competition grows, especially in simpler inference chips and from possible Google in-house chips, which could squeeze margins.

#### Sell Triggers

- guidance disappoints
- evidence of GPU price pressure
- Google or others launch competitive in-house chips

> *"Jag tror att man kan växa antalet chip framöver men också uppleva en prispress på dem, vilket kanske pressar lönsamheten en del."*

---
